sentences.text:
Sumitro Das @ Bappa & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr
on 6 January, 2026
06.01.2026
Court No.30
Item No.70
Sudipta
 Crr 5340 of 2025

Sumitro Das @ Bappa & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. A. Dutta
 Mr. Abir Chakraborty
 ...for the petitioners.

1. 
The revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing and /or setting aside of
proceedings in connection with G.R. case no. 2343/2024 corresponding to charge sheet no. 842 of
2024 dated 30.11.2024 under Sections 498A / 506 Ipc arising out of Madhyamgram Police Station
case no. 600 of 2024 dated 05.09.2024 under Sections 498A / 406 / 506 of the Ipc, presently
pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barasat.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barasat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It appears from the material on record more so the written complaint filed by the de facto
complainant on allegedly coming to know that the petitioner was already a married person along
with children.

3.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that even if the allegations are taken to be true, the provision under which the petitioner has been prima facie implicated are not made out against the petitioners herein.
4.
On perusal of the written complaint and the materials on record, it appears that the petitioners have made out a prima facie case of hearing, accordingly, the matter be listed for hearing.
5. Petitioner to serve upon opposite parties.
Affidavit of service be filed on the next date of hearing.

6. Liberty to mention on completion of service.
7.
Pending hearing of the proceedings before the learned Trial Court in connection with G.R. Case No. 2343 of 2024 be stayed till 31st March, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
